title: Deep Learning, Briefly
description: Neural networks with many layers, inspired by the brain. Deep learning uses layered neural networks to learn complex patterns from large datasets.
bodyHtml:
Neural networks with many layers, inspired by the brain.

Deep learning uses layered neural networks to learn complex patterns from large datasets. It excels at image recognition, natural language processing, and sequence modeling.

  • Convolutional networks: spatial data (images)
  • Recurrent / transformer networks: sequential data (text, audio)

title: Natural Language Processing
description: Teaching machines to understand human language. NLP powers chatbots, translation, and voice assistants through tokenization, embeddings, and LLMs.
bodyHtml:
Teaching machines to understand human language.

NLP powers chatbots, translation, and voice assistants through tokenization, embeddings, and large language models.

  • Classical pipeline: tokenize → tag → parse → extract
  • Modern approach: pretrained transformer + fine-tuning

title: Reinforcement Learning
description: Learning through trial, error, and reward. An agent interacts with an environment and learns a policy that maximizes cumulative reward over time.
bodyHtml:
Learning through trial, error, and reward.

An agent interacts with an environment, receiving rewards or penalties, and learns a policy that maximizes cumulative reward over time.

  • Used in robotics, game AI (AlphaGo), and resource allocation
  • Core trade-off: exploration vs. exploitation
